messages:
alex: Heads-up — PR #18421 is green locally but CI queue is stuck (~120 jobs). Deploy freeze in ~3h. Can someone eyeball for a quick approval + rebase window? @sana @jordan :eyes:
sana: On it. I can give an approval if CI passes quick checks. How long is the rebase window?
jordan: We can take a 15m rebase slot now if you want. CI backlog might clear faster if we rerun the flaky job group. Which job is flaky?
alex: flaky seems to be integration-linux-x64 and a couple of e2e browser tests. ci-bot shows repeated timeouts for browser-e2e on node12.
ci-bot: [CI] pipeline/18421 — 3 failing jobs (integration-linux-x64, browser-e2e-1, browser-e2e-2). Retry available. Queue position: 118. Estimated start: ~25m.
luis: If we wait for the queue we'll probably hit deploy freeze. Suggest small change: revert a noisy test only in this branch? But that changes PR semantics.
sana: Don't revert. Alex — can you run `git rebase origin/main && git push --force` now so we can try a rerun before freeze? If CI still fails we can do a manual canary after freeze with a kill-switch.
alex: Doing rebase + force now. Command: ```git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main && git push --force-with-lease```
ci-bot: [CI] pipeline/18421 — push detected, starting rerun. Queue position: 91.
jordan: I'll put an eyes request on the PR and merge rights if green. @sana can you be backup approver?
sana: Yep — will approve when green. Also add `/cherry-pick` note for release notes maintainers if we land before freeze.
luis: Quick note — canary policy: if canary latency jumps >2x after deploy we auto-rollback. Ops is on-call.
alex: CI flake still happening in browser-e2e-2, but integration passed. Filing a minimal test skip in the test harness for that flaky case and pushing a fix to the branch; will call it out in PR description.
sana: That's fine as long as skip is annotated with ISSUE link. Approving now so merge can go when CI clears :thumbsup:
ci-bot: [CI] pipeline/18421 — browser-e2e-2 failed: timeout 30m. Retry scheduled (1/2). Queue position: 60.
jordan: If retry fails, we should consider landing to dedicated (no-canary) then flip to main rollout after freeze. Alex — any blockers to that plan?
alex: No blockers from code side. Pref to land with canary, but agree fallback plan is OK.
ci-bot: [CI] pipeline/18421 — retry succeeded. All checks green.
sana: Approved.
jordan: Merging now.
alex: Merged — thanks everyone. Leaving note: landed before freeze with canary enabled. Will monitor logs (alerts subscribed). :rocket:
luis: Watching dashboards. Ping if any anomaly.
ci-bot: [Deploy] release/2026-03-17-canary started for rollout to 5% hosts.
alex: Closing thread — will post post-deploy metrics in #eng-runtime after 10m. Thanks!
